name: assets_change
display_name: Asset change of responsible or user (header)
description: GH #3889 / REQ-753 (assets C11), docs/assets/asset-workflow-documents.md. The header of a change of the material responsible or the actual user at one place (cause change, prefix ACH). It is written only by module assets (managed type), same shape rules as assets_commission: document_id is the id of the versioned document that carries state and number; org_unit_id is the issuing (handing) org unit, the scope column. Master ids are record ids of other modules (no foreign key; checked at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes. No price or value is stored.
